pregunta: Tap the part of the model that works as the camera's “sunglasses”.
explicacion: The ND filter is inside the camera. View the model in layers to find it.

pregunta: You can't change any camera setting. What do you check first?
opciones: That the AUTO/MANUAL switch is on MANUAL
explicacion: In AUTO the camera decides everything and locks the manual settings.

pregunta: You adjusted the iris and press the IRIS button again. What happens?
opciones: The iris goes back to automatic
explicacion: To lock the value you press the multi-selector. Pressing IRIS again sends it back to automatic.

pregunta: Tap the part where you connect a professional XLR microphone.
explicacion: The two XLR inputs are at the front of the handle.

pregunta: Which recording format does the CPMA recommend because it works with any card?
explicacion: It's set in Menu → Recording Settings → File Format.

pregunta: You're in manual focus, but turning the ring changes the zoom. What do you do?
opciones: Set the switch beside the lens to FOCUS
explicacion: The FOCUS/ZOOM switch decides what the lens ring does.

pregunta: You finished the interview and will record supporting shots. Which microphone do you choose in the menu?
explicacion: With the internal microphone, the shots keep ambient sound without the interviewee's voice.

pregunta: Put in order the path light follows until it becomes an image.
explicacion: Light enters through the lens, passes the ND filter and reaches the sensor.
